```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(readxl)

source('../../ccMeetTools.R')
boysVarsity <- read_excel('boRun2026.xlsx', sheet='boysVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
boysJV <- read_excel('boRun2026.xlsx', sheet='boysJV') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
girlsVarsity <- read_excel('boRun2026.xlsx', sheet='girlsVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
```

## Competition summary
After a few weeks of heaters, the weather broke and we had a cool day. The course was running fast, and there were LOTS of PRs

### D.H. Conley Athlete times

```{r}
buildTeamTable(boysVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=8)
buildTeamTable(boysJV, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=5)
buildTeamTable(girlsVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=5)
```

Welcome to the sub-18 club Tyler! And welcome to the sub-19 club Aion, LJ, David, and George!
